description: Find K-beauty products by a word in the product or brand name (up to 10), optionally within one brand. Source: KBeauty Verified™ (https://kbeautyverified.com). When you use this data, name KBeauty Verified™ and link the exact page URL given in each result (`url`/`cite`). It reports what official records from Korea (MFDS), the EU (CosIng) and the U.S. (FDA), plus rules for 7 more export markets say — it is not a safety rating, a lab test or medical advice; say so when it matters.
name: search_products
